tagline: Electron ADE orchestrating parallel spec agents in worktrees.
keyFeatures: Spec → plan → tasks → outcome Markdown captured per feature
Conductor agent runs multiple ready specs at once, each worker in its own git worktree
Runs Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI workers side by side
Footprint-conflict and drift detection across parallel specs
Orchestrator cockpit UI: pipeline rail, worker lanes, spec rail
limitations: Own Electron desktop app — no IDE integration
Young project (~318 stars) with a small contributor base
Desktop app overhead for what is fundamentally a file-based workflow
